title: Witch on the Holy Night Film's Final Trailer Unveils Staff, Theme Song
content:
The official website of the Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) anime film started streaming the film's final trailer on Wednesday. The trailer reveals and previews the theme song "Yoru to Ao" (Night and Blue) by supercell , and it also confirms the staff.

The anime's staff also presented a new character visual drawn by Hirokazu Koyama :

The staff members are:

• Director: Masashi Takeuchi

• Character Design: Moe Tsuzuki

• Chief Animation Director: Masato Nagamori

• Script Production: ufotable

• Sub-Character Design: Nana Ishigo, Masato Nagamori

• Prop Design: Masato Saitō

• Compositing Director of Photography/Finishing Technical Director: Yuichi Terao

• 3D Director: Gōchū Satō

• Art Director: Koji Eto

• Color Key Artist: Mika Matsuoka

• Editing: Manabu Kamino

• Music: Hideyuki Fukasawa

• Chief Director: Hikaru Kondo

Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will screen the film in the U.S. and Canada on January 29, 2027. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .

The film will feature returning cast:

• Haruka Tomatsu as Aoko Aozaki

• Kana Hanazawa as Alice Kuonji

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Soujyuro Sizuki

The story of the original Witch on the Holy Night visual novel is set in the late 1980s, and centers on protagonist Aoko Aozaki, one of two sister heirs to a long family line of modern mages. Although she is disinterested in magic, she is suddenly declared as the heir of their family's magical art, and reluctantly begins her apprenticeship under Alice Kuonji, a young witch who lives in a lonely manor atop a hill. Aoko balances her duties of learning the arcane, while also serving as her school's student council president. She also makes the acquaintance of Sōjūrō Shizuki (romanized as Soujyuro Sizuki in the English version of the game), a new transfer student who is unfamiliar with much of the modern world, and contends with the plots of her older sister Tōko Aozaki, who feels that her birthright has been denied.

Type-Moon most recently released the game on Steam in December 2023.

Aniplex released the PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch version of the game in the West in December 2022, on the same day as the game's Japanese release date. The PS4 and Switch versions have sold more than 150,000 copies worldwide.

Mahōtsukai no Yoru was one of the first collaborations between Kinoko Nasu and artist Takashi Takeuchi in the mid-90s, preceding their founding of Type-Moon . Initially a novel, Nasu and Takeuchi only showed the draft to friends and did not officially release it. Type-Moon eventually developed it into a visual novel with graphics by Hirokazu Koyama that shipped in April 2012, with two sequels planned.

The story is noted for being one of the few tangible connections in the loosely connected "Nasuverse," the English-speaking fan term for the shared universe and cosmology in Type-Moon 's works, including Tsukihime , Fate/stay night , and The Garden of Sinners . An older Aoko Aozaki is an early mentor to Tsukihime protagonist Shiki Tohno, while an older Tōko Aozaki is an employer to Garden of Sinners protagonist Shiki Ryōgi. Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon-, the remake of Type-Moon 's Tsukihime dōjin visual novel game, launched in Japan for PlayStation 4 and Switch in August 2021. The game launched on PS4 and Switch in English in June 2024.

title: Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar Anime Casts Risa Hayamizu
content:
The official website for Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar ), the original television anime by French entertainment company Ankama , revealed a new cast member on Wednesday. Risa Hayamizu voices Mama Caroni, Welsh's adoptive mother and cooking mentor.

The anime's staff also revealed character visuals for two previously announced cast members:

Wataru Takagi as Khan Karkass, a hero from Bonta who accompanies Welsh and the others on their adventures

Show Hayami as Azalar, the most powerful dragon who looms before Welsh and the others

The anime's story centers on a country boy named Welsh, and a prince destined to become a king named Shedar. The two boys are from different stations in life, but their destinies intertwine when they try to end a tyrant's plot to conquer the world.

The anime will star:

• Rikuya Yasuda as Welsh

• Yūki Kaji as Shedar

• Yūko Kaida as Zabel

• Makoto Furukawa as Joris

• Risa Kayama as Bechamel

Naoki Horiuchi (episode director for Kingdom second season, Black Clover , Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- ) is directing the anime at Studio Massket . Saori Nakashiki ( Sasaki and Peeps , Tales of Wedding Rings ) is designing the characters, and Nakashiki is also one of the chief animation directors alongside Yoshiaki Tsubata ( Date A Live IV ) and Yuki Ikeda ( WAVE!! -Let's go surfing!! movie trilogy).

Eri Suzuki ( Black Summoner ) is the color key artist, and Studio Massket is also in charge of anime background art. Lucas Cisterne (3D CG for The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is in charge of art setting, Jun Watanabe ( Ascendance of a Bookworm ) is directing the sound at TO Books , and Pierre-Jean Beaudoin & Jose Pavli are composing the music. Tot is credited for the original work, scripts, and drafting the series story outline. Kenichi Yamashita ( MF Ghost ) is in charge of the series scripts for the anime's Japanese version. Takuya Imakado ( The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is the series' monster designer.

Artists Hironobu Kageyama and Masami Okui will perform the theme song "Bokura no Mirai e" (To Our Future). Kageyama will also perform the ending theme song "Omelette." Kageyama & KUKO will perform the insert song "I'm in you."

The anime will premiere on October 2 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST (8:25 a.m. EDT).

Ankama is an independent entertainment and digital creation group most widely known for the DOFUS tactical MMORPG, which launched in 2004. The company also published Atsushi Kaneko 's SOIL manga , and Suguro Chayamachi 's Togainu no Chi manga in French.

title: 'Mahoutsukai no Yoru' Reveals Production Staff, Final Trailer, Theme Song
content:
The special livestream presentation for the anime movie adaptation of Type-Moon 's Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) visual novel reveals production staff, theme song, and final promotional video on Wednesday. Produced by ufotable , the film is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on November 20.

Staff Director: Masashi Takeuchi ( Kimetsu no Yaiba Movie: Mugen Ressha-hen episode director) Chief Director: Hikaru Kondou ( Kimetsu no Yaiba Movie 1: Mugenjou-hen - Akaza Sairai ) Script Production: ufotable Chief Animation Director: Masato Nagamori ( Kimetsu no Yaiba: Katanakaji no Sato-hen ) Character Design: Moe Tsuzuki ( Katsugeki/Touken Ranbu ) Sub-Character Design: Nana Ishigo ( Fate/stay night Movie: Heaven's Feel - III. Spring Song animation director), Masato Nagamori Prop Design: Masato Saito 3D Director: Gochu Sato Art Director: Kouji Etou ( Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works ) Color Design: Mika Matsuoka ( Fate/stay night Movie: Heaven's Feel - II. Lost Butterfly ) Editing: Manabu Kamino ( Kimetsu no Yaiba: Yuukaku-hen ) Director of Photography: Yuuichi Terao ( Fate/stay night Movie: Heaven's Feel - I. Presage Flower ) Music: Hideyuki Fukasawa ( Gnosia )

Japanese pop band supercell ( Monogatari Series: Second Season ) is performing the theme song "Yoru to Ao," which is previewed in the trailer below.

Developed and published by Type-Moon, the visual novel Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) was launched for Windows in Japan in April 2012. An enhanced remaster debuted on Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4 in December 2022, followed by a Steam port in December 2023. It later received a worldwide release in December 2023. Written by Kinoko Nasu , it serves as a prequel to Shingetsutan Tsukihime ( Lunar Legend Tsukihime ) within the shared Nasuverse.

Final Trailer

title: The World's Strongest Witch Anime Casts Nana Mizuki
content:
The official website for the television anime of Mochimaru Sakaki 's The World's Strongest Witch: I'm Starting My Free Life in a World Where Only I Can See the Online Strategy Guide ( Sekai Saikyō no Majo, Hajimemashita : Watashi dake "Kōryaku Site" o Mireru Sekai de Jiyū ni Ikimasu) light novel series announced on Wednesday that Nana Mizuki will voice Yggdrasil, the spirit of the World Tree. The character will appear in the anime's first episode on October 7.

Yen Press is releasing the light novels in English, and will release the third volume on November 10. Yen Press describes the story:

When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, “Internet.” This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what "lmfao" means…

The anime stars:

• Azusa Tachibana as Rona Hermit

• Fairouz Ai as Erimina

• Honoka Inoue as Eruna

• Kana Hanazawa as Aries Tear Bluemoon

• Maria Naganawa as Ruru Ru Rie

• Yūto Uemura voices Reinhardt Highwind

Jōji Furuta ( ēlDLIVE , Double Decker! Doug & Kirill , Bad Girl ) is directing the anime at the studios Bridge and Aisle . Shoji Yonemura (Pokémon Journeys: The Series, One Piece 2013-onwards, Bad Girl ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yūki Morimoto ( Cardfight!! Vanguard GZ , Boarding School Juliet , Bad Girl ) is designing the characters.

Additional staff members include:

• Art Director: Asuka Komiyama

• Color Key Artist: Megumi Aoi

• Compositing Director of Photography: Toshiyuki Sadamatsu

• Editing: Kumiko Sakamoto

• Music: Arisa Okehazama (The Apothecary Diaries, Jujutsu Kaisen), Ryoshi Takagi (Multi-Mind Mayhem: Isekai Tensei Soudouki)

• Sound Director: Takeshi Takadera

• Sound Production: Bit Grooove Promotion

HoneyWorks feat. HaKoniwalily perform the opening theme song "Eikyōryoku∞Idol" (Infinitely Influential Idol), and the group Rokudenashi performs the ending theme song " Hoshi o Muguru" (Traversing the Stars).

The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX , BS11 , and TV Aichi channels on October 7, and on MBS on October 10.

Mochimaru Sakaki began serializing the original story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in May 2022. Square Enix published the first print novel volume in December 2022, with illustrations by riritto . The sixth novel volume will ship on October 7.

Tamaki Toga launched a manga adaptation in Kodansha 's Getsu Maga Kichi/ Comic Days website in May 2023. Kodansha published the manga's 14th compiled book volume on October 8.

Comikey publishes both Daisuke Takashima 's manga adaptation of Sakaki's The Strongest Swordsman Has Zero Equipment Slots novel series, as well as Namiki Tsukiyama 's manga adaptation of Sakaki's Final Boss Fake-out novel series in English. Square Enix also publishes both manga in English on its Manga UP! Global website.

title: The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me Anime's 1st Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, January Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of writer Kotoko and artist Kaname Hanamiya 's The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me ( Odebu Akujo ni Tensei Shitara, Nazeka Last Boss О̄jisama ni Shūchaku Sareteimasu ) manga presented on Wednesday the anime's first full promotional video, first key visual, additional cast and staff members, and its January 2027 premiere. The anime will run on the Tokyo MX , BS NTV , AT-X and CBC TV channels, and will stream on the d Anime Store streaming service in Japan.

The newly announced cast members are:

Shunichi Toki as Lewis, the first-born prince of the kingdom

Fūka Izumi as Adele, Celine's little sister

The additional staff members include:

• Character Designer: Nozomi Ikuyama (This Monster Wants to Eat Me)

• Art Directors: Yuri Takagi, Keito Watanabe

• 3D Art Setting/3D Layout: Jishiro Shida

• Color Key Artist: Taeko Mizuno

• 2D Design: Suguru Shiga

• Compositing Director of Photography: Kenji Takehara

• Editing: Hitomi Sudō

• Sound Director: Ryōsuke Naya

• Sound Effects: Yuka Kazama

• Music: Tsubasa Itō (Skeleton Knight in Another World, A Girl & Her Guard Dog, Iwa-Kakeru! -Sport Climbing Girls-)

The staff previously announced that Fumino Kakihata and Yukiko Sekita are also designing the characters.

Media Do , NTT Docomo , Akatsuki Group, and MyAnimeList 's joint digital manga distribution service Manga Mirai is publishing the series in English ( until December), and it describes the story:

After dying of illness, she has been reincarnated as Celine, the selfish, fat, villainous duchess, sister of the heroine of a popular novel. If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession..! Will Celine be able to find “peaceful happiness”? A fantasy love story about a reincarnation in another world where she is loved too much by a Yandere.

The anime stars Haruka Shiraishi as Celine and Takeo Ōtsuka as Wilfred.

Naoyuki Kuzuya ( Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time ) is directing the anime at Studio Lings with Shūsaku Katо̄ as the assistant director. Mitsutaka Hirota ( Edens Zero ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. Infinite is producing.

Kotoko and Hanamiya launch the manga in April 2023. The fifth compiled book volume shipped in Japan on February 14. The series has over 70 million downloads.

title: 'Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duo' Theatrical Release Postponed
content:
The official website for the Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duo ( Fairy Princess Minky Momo ) original video anime announced on Wednesday that its theatrical release has been postponed due to production circumstances. The OVA was originally scheduled to open in Japan on November 13. A new release date will be announced at a later time.

The production committee apologized to viewers and related parties for the postponement. Advance tickets that have already been purchased will remain valid for the rescheduled theatrical release.

Ayumu Watanabe ( Summertime Render ) is directing at Ashi Productions and Deko Akao ( Witch Watch ) is penning the script. title: 'Odebu Akujo ni Tensei shitara, Nazeka Last Boss Oujisama ni Shuuchaku sareteimasu' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kotoko and Kaname Hanamiya 's Odebu Akujo ni Tensei shitara, Nazeka Last Boss Oujisama ni Shuuchaku sareteimasu ( The Final-Boss Prince Is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me ) web manga revealed additional cast, staff, a first key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime will premiere on Tokyo MX, BS Nippon, AT-X, CBC TV, and other stations in January 2027.

Voice actors Shunichi Toki ( Kuroneko to Majo no Kyoushitsu ) and Fuuka Izumi ( Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu. ) are joining the cast as Louis and Adele, respectively.

Staff Art Director: Yuri Takagi ( Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu! ), Keito Watanabe ( Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! ) 3D Art Setting: Jishiro Shida Color Design: Taeko Mizuno ( Ragna Crimson ) 2D Design: Suguru Shiga Director of Photography: Kenji Takehara ( Watashi wo Tabetai, Hitodenashi ) Editing: Hitomi Sudou ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) Sound Director: Ryousuke Naya ( Hanaori-san wa Tensei shitemo Kenka ga Shitai ) Sound Effects: Yuka Kazama ( Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game ) Music: Tsubasa Itou ( Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai )

Naoyuki Kuzuya ( Eiyuuou, Bu wo Kiwameru Tame Tenseisu ) is directing the anime at Studio Lings , with Shuusaku Katou ( Sorairo Utility (TV) episode director) serving as the assistant director. Mitsutaka Hirota ( Kanojo ga Koushaku-tei ni Itta Riyuu ) is handling the series composition and script. Fumino Kakihata ( Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu! chief animation director) and Yukiko Sekita ( Maou no Ore ga Dorei Elf wo Yome ni Shitanda ga, Dou Medereba Ii? animation director) are designing the characters.

Kotoko and Hanamiya began serializing the fantasy romance web manga on the Mecha Comic and Comico Japan in April 2023. Kadokawa Shoten released the fifth volume on February 14.

NHN comico Corp. originally licensed the manga for digital release in English through their Pocket Comics platform in September 2024. The series has been licensed by Manga Mirai since October 2025.

title: New Fairy Princess Minky Momo Original Video Anime Delayed
content:
The committee apologized to fans looking forward to the anime and all those involved in the production, and said it will announce the new opening date, as soon as it is decided, on the anime's official website and social media accounts. People who bought advance tickets for the screenings can still use them after the new opening date.

The new OVA 's story is set in Diginarsa, the land of dreams and hopes, which maintains its existence through dream energy. But the land is in danger of disappearing as humans lose their dreams and hopes, and the dream energy decreases. As a last resort, the land's king sends off his three companions Chamocha, Dettabook, and Pipirupi to Min ky Momo for help.

On her 12th birthday, a girl named Momo received a smartphone as a present, and awakens as Min ky Momo after meeting the king's companions and resolves herself to save Diginarsa. As Momo steadily collects dream energy, a mysterious app begins to become popular in the city. But the dreams that children talk about in the app are nothing but frivolous dreams only driven by the desire for recognition or boosting their viewing numbers. Momo starts to question everyone's dreams.

The OVA stars:

• Kurumi Haruki as Minky Momo

• Fukushi Ochiai as Dettabook

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Chamocha

• Rie Kugimiya as Pipirupi

• Tomohito Takatsuka as Rubato

• Yōko Hikasa as Peter

• Show Hayami as the King of Diginarsa

• Kikuko Inoue as the Queen of Diginarsa

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Momo's kind father

• Mie Sonozaki as Momo's mother, who is a bit of a worrywart

Ayumu Watanabe ( Witch Hat Atelier , Akane-banashi , Space Brothers ) is directing the anime at Ashi Production . The original 1982-1983 anime's main animator Hiroshi Watanabe and Minky Momo in The Station of Your Memories key animator Mari Tominaga are designing the characters. Deko Akao ( Arakawa Under the Bridge two seasons, Pretty Rhythm Aurora Dream ) is writing the script, Katsunori Shimizu ( Magical Girl Ore , Citrus) is the sound director, Zack Promotion is in charge of sound production, and Tomoki Hasegawa ( Minky Momo in The Station of Your Memories , Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?! ) is composing the music. Studio Live is credited for design cooperation. MOVIC and Giggly Box are distributing.

The new OVA will be the franchise 's first new one since 1994's Minky Momo in The Station of Your Memories , 32 years ago.

William Winckler Productions launched an Amazon Instant Video release of the 1982-1983 television anime as English-dubbed features in 2015, and it described the story:

In Minky Momo , a princess from a magical world is sent to Earth to help people recover their lost hopes and dreams. Using her magic, and with the aid of her magical dog, monkey and bird, Minky – known on Earth as “Gigi” – encounters amazing adventures.

The 1982-1983 series inspired a television series followup in 1991-1992 and several OVAs. Harmony Gold USA released the Fairy Princess Minky Momo: La ronde in my dream OVA in English as Gigi and the Fountain of Youth . Crunchyroll began streaming the original television anime in January 2024.

title: Voice Actor Kenjirō Tsuda's TikTok Lawsuit Dismissed After AI-Voiced Videos' Removal
content:
The Singaporean company that operates TikTok in Japan reported that the videos had been removed after the lawsuit's November 2025 filing. Thus, the company argued that Tsuda no longer has a legal interest in continuing the case.

According to the lawsuit's filing, an unidentified individual owned the TikTok account that posted at least 188 videos dealing with urban legends and conspiracy theories between July 2024 and September 2025. According to information the individual posted on another site, the revenue from the videos was estimated between 500,000 and 750,000 yen (about US$3,000 to US$4,500) per month.

Tsuda's legal team argued that the videos featured narration generated by AI to imitate Tsuda's characteristic "smooth, low-pitched" and "deep, husky" voice. They claimed that the videos were misleading viewers into believing that the narration is Tsuda's voice, thus attracting them. Tsuda's camp had sought the removal of the videos based on the Unfair Competition Prevention Act and the right of publicity, which is the right to protect the image of public figures such as celebrities and entertainers.

The defense had argued that the voice in the narration was a "universal male voice" generated by training AI on the voice of the poster's friend, as was stated on the poster's external website. The company's lawyers argued that there was no confusion and therefore no violation of the law. TikTok also denied any infringement of publicity rights, arguing that most of the comments on the videos were opinions and reactions regarding to the content, and the viewers were not drawn in by the voice of the narration.

In related news, an expert panel for the Ministry of Justice issued guidelines in August on how to interpret the existing laws to protect voices from unauthorized generative AI use. The guidelines indicated that the voices of voice actors and actors are legally protected under the right of publicity, just as their likenesses (e.g. photographs) are. The guidelines also indicated that depending on how much they infringed on that right, generative AI providers could face joint liability.

title: Phoenix Gramedia Licenses Imasara Desu ga, Osananajimi o Suki ni Natte Shimaimashita Light Novel
content:
Kadokawa and Gramedia's Phoenix Gramedia company announced on Tuesday that it has licensed Fumiaki Maruto and Yom 's Imasara Desu ga, Osananajimi o Suki ni Natte Shimaimashita light novel, and will release it "soon."

The story centers on the relationship between high school girl Hikari and her childhood friend of 10 years nicknamed Ta-kun. Now as high schoolers, their relationship becomes closer and closer, until it reaches a turning point. Though seemingly straightforward, their romance takes unexpected twists and turns later in the story.

Maruto and Yom launched the light novel and manga at the same time, and they continue to be serialized. Maruto serializes the chapters in the note website, with accompanying illustrations by Yom . Yom also draws the manga adaptation, which runs in both X/Twitter and Comic Apanta.

Kadokawa published the first novel volume and the first compiled book volume for the manga both in August 2025, and released the second novel volume and second manga volume on March 10.

Maruto is perhaps best known for penning the story to the White Album 2 romantic drama visual novel. The visual novel inspired a 2010 television anime. Maruto also wrote the Saenai Heroine no Sodate-kata ( How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ) light novel series, which inspired a manga adaptation, two television anime seasons, and a film. Maruto is also the head writer for the Classroom Crisis , Engage Kiss , SI-VIS: The Sound of Heroes original anime.
